From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Financial term

Earnings are the net benefits of a corporation's operation. Earnings are also the amount on which corporate tax is due. For an analysis of specific aspects of corporate operations several more specific terms are used as EBIT (earnings before interest and taxes) and EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization). [...] Many alternative terms for earnings are commonly used, such as income and profit "Profit (accounting)"). These terms in turn have a variety of definitions, depending on their context and the objectives of the authors. For instance, the IRS uses the term profit to describe earnings, whereas for the corporation the profit it reports is the amount left after taxes are taken out.

# Calendar

## How to use the Earnings Calendar?

TradingView’s Earnings Calendar shows the latest and upcoming earnings reports released by companies. As an important indicator of a company’s financial state, earnings per share are one of the most followed metrics among traders, so the calendar above can serve as a powerful tool for analysis. [...] With buttons on the upper panel, you can customize the calendar — choose a time period, country, and time zone to see only those reports that suit your strategy. This way, you can decide to see only the earnings of US companies or track reports globally. When all is set, you can easily shift through the calendar to plan your next move.

You can follow companies' earnings in more detail on corresponding symbol pages. Track Tesla's earnings, Amazon's earnings, and even more.
